<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

  <li><strong>Parliamentary concerns:</strong> Congress leader Jairam Ramesh has alleged that the government may use the unprorogued Parliament session to push through contentious Delimitation Bills.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Leadership shifts:</strong> National Conference MP Aga Ruhullah has resigned from his Srinagar Lok Sabha seat, marking a significant political setback for the Omar Abdullah-led party.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi--?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial oversight on protests:</strong> The Supreme Court has ruled that designated protest sites cannot be occupied indefinitely, emphasizing the need to balance the right to protest with the livelihoods of daily wagers.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W18</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxNMFMyWVA4MThqMWhrYm1VeVZNTFNJSzJjOGFOZHliaVZSWEdTV1JkTWdNMEdacDRwZ1I3dURLcC02eEJDbXY0RFVOUDFwQVhDUzlFRnZqYmNjV1I4MC1WeDdwRlhSUHE5ZFVyOGthQ3RBNXhvU295aHV3SnRsVUo3aUtXOTVwVG8?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Supreme Court intervention:</strong> The apex court has sought responses from the Centre regarding festive-season protests against the Election Commission and ongoing environmental concerns over oil drilling near an Assam national park.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
